Welcome. I'm Dr. Nicole Mercado, a Latina chiropractor, a wife, a mom, and a faith-driven woman who believes your body was made to function well. I specialize in upper cervical chiropractic care at Lufkin Clinic of Chiropractic in Lufkin, Texas, where our mission is simple: where healing begins. 

Every patient who walks through our doors is proof that this work is bigger than me. I do not heal anyone. I remove the interference. God does the healing.  

On this channel, you will find real education about how your nervous system controls everything, what upper cervical care actually is, patient stories that will move you, and a look inside a clinic that truly cares about your family. From newborns to athletes to grandparents, we see them all.  If you have been told to just live with it, this channel is for you.  

Subscribe, learn, and when you are ready, we are here.  
Lufkin Clinic of Chiropractic. Where healing begins.  

📍 Lufkin, TX 
📞 (936) 899-6158 
📧 lufkinchiropractic@gmail.com
